scope: separate old-development end-to-end input-convention comparison, not a replacement of the frozen studies
motivation: Noiseless reconstruction and fixed-mask token prediction do not provide one common performance ordering; evaluate actual channel reconstruction under matched conditions
geometry: RGB, Resize((256,256)), ToTensor shared across all paths; no crop change
mask: sender-truth oracle packet mask independently determined for each transmitted token stream; shared by the two class modes within a pipeline
class_condition: same true ImageNet class, direct perfect side-information assumption; no CMI transport simulated
physical_chain: existing Sionna 0.19.2 AWGN CRC11 convolutional [101,111] soft Viterbi 16-QAM
interleaver: author-demo fixed token index mod64; not paper randomized packet positions
common_noise: same image/trial seed for both pipelines; transmitted symbols may differ
metrics: PSNR from unclipped defined output vs original x; LPIPS on clipped output with normalize=True; CLIP on clipped PIL output with official preprocess
token_metrics: exact final-ID equality against that pipeline source tokens; do not compare different encoder IDs as channel errors
aggregation: Require all ten images and all five receptions in both pipelines and all four paths before between-pipeline quality means. Average five trials within image, then ten paired images. Retain every path and image difference; select no winner.
reuse_policy: Reuse demo caches only when source tokens, PHY seed, generation settings, metric convention and all identities match; never change existing locks or summaries
interpretation: Exploratory reused development cohort; not independent validation or paper-wide reproduction. Any future definitive protocol requires separately preregistered validation.
